svg.title: Financial and real-economy stress peak at different times
svg.desc: Three monthly blocks on an identical vertical scale. Market stress peaks in May 1932; banking and monetary stress peaks in March 1932; real-economy distress peaks in March 1933. The real block includes unemployment, bankruptcies, and court-administered settlements.
